About Stop60

Made with passion, free for everyone

Stop60 is a small collection of free games you play straight in your browser, in English, Norwegian and Polish. Every game starts in seconds, works on a phone held upright or sideways, and needs no account, no download and no ads.

Start with today’s Pure Logic puzzle – the same board for everyone, so you can compare emoji results with friends. Or try a quick round of Ufobang, steer the Lava Marble over the lava, play the Hefau board game against the computer or a friend, or squash bugs for one minute in Sneaky Bugs. New games and updates arrive often, so it is worth coming back.

Free for everyone

Every game is completely free. No ads, no in-game purchases and no account.

Right in your browser

Open the link and play – on a phone, tablet or computer. Want it as an app? Choose “Add to Home Screen”.

Three languages

The site and most games are available in Norwegian, English and Polish.

Privacy

This site uses no cookies. Visits are counted anonymously with GoatCounter (self-hosted script): only aggregate statistics are stored. IP address and browser are kept only in the server’s memory for up to 8 hours to count unique visits, and are not stored. The games have their own privacy pages with the data controller, your rights and contact details.
